NAME: GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag cached on first is_enabled() call; any defined value, including empty or "0", disables. Unset permits CUDA graphs unless the GPU architecture independently disables them; relevant only when compiled with USE_CUDA_GRAPH.
PURPOSE: Disable vendored GGML CUDA graph capture/replay and execute through the ordinary CUDA path.

NAME: HOME
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Filesystem directory string. In ds4-agent, unset or empty falls back to "." for the default cache and history roots; the web helper applies the same fallback for its browser profile. A nonempty value roots .ds4/kvcache, .ds4_agent_history and .ds4/browser.
PURPOSE: Choose the user's persistent ds4-agent cache, line-history and Chrome-profile base directory.

NAME: LINENOISE_ASSUME_TTY
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence test flag: any defined value, including empty or "0", treats non-TTY input as interactive while skipping real termios raw-mode setup/restoration. Unset follows isatty and uses plain blocking line input for pipes.
PURPOSE: Exercise the live linenoise/agent editor, prompt and status layout in automated pipe-based tests without a real terminal.

NAME: LINENOISE_COLS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: If defined, its value is returned directly through atoi with no validation: empty/nonnumeric becomes 0 and signed values are accepted. If unset, linenoise uses TIOCGWINSZ, then a cursor-position query, then fallback width 80.
PURPOSE: Force a deterministic terminal column count for linenoise wrapping/layout tests.

NAME: PATH
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Colon-separated executable search directories consulted only after DS4_CHROME, macOS app paths and fixed Chrome/Chromium paths fail. The first executable google-chrome, google-chrome-stable, chromium or chromium-browser wins; unset/empty/no match falls back to the literal command google-chrome, which execlp may search again.
PURPOSE: Locate a Chrome/Chromium executable for the ds4 web/CDP tool.

NAME: TERM
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Case-insensitive terminal name. Values dumb, cons25, or emacs select linenoise's simple prompt plus blocking line reader; unset, empty, or any other value selects the normal interactive editor when stdin is a TTY.
PURPOSE: Avoid ANSI/raw interactive editing on terminal types known not to support the required escape sequences.

NAME: DS4_BENCH_DISABLE_SNAPSHOT
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset allows snapshots for eligible frontiers
PURPOSE: Disable benchmark state snapshots.

NAME: DS4_BENCH_FORCE_SNAPSHOT
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset obeys the normal size/eligibility checks
PURPOSE: Force benchmark state snapshots despite the normal limit.

NAME: DS4_BENCH_SNAPSHOT_MAX_BYTES
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: unsigned bytes or unlimited/inf; default DS4_BENCH_DEFAULT_SNAPSHOT_MAX_BYTES
PURPOSE: Limit session snapshot size during benchmark sweeps.

NAME: DS4_CLI_FORCE_SESSION
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag: any defined value, including empty or "0", forces the session path. Unset uses the session path only for distributed coordinators, TP leaders, temperature>0, or MTP depth>1; otherwise the CLI calls direct argmax generation.
PURPOSE: Force ordinary CLI generation through run_sampled_generation/session APIs so single-node validation follows the same stateful path as TP/distributed runs.

NAME: DS4_BATCHED_FFN
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag: any defined value, including empty or "0", enables. Unset leaves the default shared-expert-batched FFN path (or its configured fallback). It is read only by CPU layer-major prefill and takes precedence over shared-batch and token-parallel FFN choices.
PURPOSE: Run the complete CPU prefill FFN in chunks through layer_ffn_batch instead of the default shared-expert-only batched path.

NAME: DS4_BATCHED_ROPE_MAX
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Nonempty value parsed by strtol without full-string validation; integers 0..65536 are accepted, otherwise default 4096. Zero disables batched RoPE for every nonempty prompt. Effective only when prefix batch attention is selected and DS4_NO_BATCHED_ROPE is absent.
PURPOSE: Set the largest CPU prefix-prefill token batch that applies RoPE and inverse RoPE with the batched kernels.

NAME: DS4_DECODE_PROFILE_DETAIL
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset=off
PURPOSE: Print per-stage timing for the single-token CPU FFN path.

NAME: DS4_EXPERT_HOTLIST
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: nonempty filesystem path; unset=off; currently Metal-only
PURPOSE: Load an expert hotlist for Metal expert profiling/streaming.

NAME: DS4_EXPERT_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence diagnostic flag; unset=off
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for expert profile.

NAME: DS4_LOCK_FILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: path string; default /tmp/ds4.lock
PURPOSE: Override the single-instance lock file.

NAME: DS4_NO_BATCHED_ATTN
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence rollback flag; unset keeps default/optimized path
PURPOSE: Disable/roll back no batched attn.

NAME: DS4_NO_BATCHED_ROPE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence rollback flag; unset keeps default/optimized path
PURPOSE: Disable/roll back no batched rope.

NAME: DS4_NO_PARALLEL_ATTN_ROWS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence rollback flag; unset keeps default/optimized path
PURPOSE: Disable/roll back no parallel attn rows.

NAME: DS4_NO_ROUTED_TOKEN_PARALLEL
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence rollback flag; unset keeps default/optimized path
PURPOSE: Disable/roll back no routed token parallel.

NAME: DS4_NO_SHARED_BATCH_FFN
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence rollback flag; unset keeps default/optimized path
PURPOSE: Disable/roll back no shared batch ffn.

NAME: DS4_ORACLE_LOGITS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: filesystem path; unset disables read/write
PURPOSE: Load reference logits for graph correctness comparison.

NAME: DS4_PARALLEL_ATTN_ROWS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence opt-in; any defined value enables the preference, but DS4_NO_PARALLEL_ATTN_ROWS overrides it. The path is eligible only for prefix prefill with cache n_raw==0 and pos0==0; unset uses per-token attention rows.
PURPOSE: Batch/parallelize CPU prefix attention-row evaluation after cache/index preparation.

NAME: DS4_PARALLEL_FFN
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence opt-in. It is effective only in CPU prefill when batched attention is enabled, DS4_BATCHED_FFN is absent, and the default shared-batch path has been disabled with DS4_NO_SHARED_BATCH_FFN; otherwise higher-priority paths win.
PURPOSE: Run independent prompt-token FFNs through layer_ffn_tokens_parallel as the fallback after disabling shared batching.

NAME: DS4_PREFILL_BATCH
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Nonempty value parsed by strtol without full-string validation; accepted range 1..4095, default 128 for unset/invalid/out-of-range values. It is used only when DS4_BATCHED_FFN selects full batched CPU FFN.
PURPOSE: Set the token chunk size for layer_ffn_batch during CPU layer-major prefill.

NAME: DS4_PREFILL_PROFILE_DETAIL
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset=off
PURPOSE: Print detailed per-stage CPU prefill timing.

NAME: DS4_PREFILL_PROFILE_TOKEN
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; effective within detailed prefill profiling
PURPOSE: Print token-loop substage timings during CPU prefill.

NAME: DS4_ROUTED_TOKEN_PARALLEL
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag that forces token-parallel routed MoE, even if DS4_NO_ROUTED_TOKEN_PARALLEL is also set. When unset, token parallelism is automatic for n_tok>=64 unless the NO flag is present; smaller batches use per-token routed MoE.
PURPOSE: Choose token-parallel CPU routed-expert evaluation inside the default shared-batch FFN prefill path.

NAME: DS4_THREADS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: positive integer; default min(online CPUs,12), capped by DS4_MAX_THREADS; CLI thread request overrides env
PURPOSE: Set CPU worker-pool size.

NAME: DS4_TOKEN_TIMING
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag; default off. Any defined value times and prints each CPU token decode evaluation; sampling, emission and callbacks are outside the measured interval.
PURPOSE: Report per-token CPU model-evaluation latency during direct argmax generation.

NAME: DS4_TRACE_TOP
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset=off
PURPOSE: Print top-logit/token trace data during CPU generation.

NAME: DS4_CPU_DISABLE_UNROLLED_ARGMAX
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence rollback flag; unset keeps optimized/default path
PURPOSE: Disable/roll back cpu disable unrolled argmax.

NAME: DS4_CPU_DUMP_LOGITS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: filesystem path; unset disables read/write
PURPOSE: Dump or select diagnostic data for cpu dump logits.

NAME: DS4_CPU_DUMP_PREFILL_LOGITS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: filesystem path; unset disables read/write
PURPOSE: Dump or select diagnostic data for cpu dump prefill logits.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_ATTENTION_OUTPUT_A_CUBLAS_MIN
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: integer tokens; default 2; accepted range 2..4095, otherwise 2
PURPOSE: Set the token-count threshold for using cuBLAS on attention output-A.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_ATTENTION_OUTPUT_PRELOAD
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset does not force the path; any defined value including 0 is true; eligibility/auto-policy still applies
PURPOSE: Allow attention-output Q8 weights to be preloaded into the selective F16 cache.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_ATTN_OUTPUT_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence diagnostic flag; default off; any defined value including 0 enables
PURPOSE: Measure and print CUDA attention-output stage timings.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_ATTN_Q_B_F32_CACHE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset does not force the path; any defined value including 0 is true; eligibility/auto-policy still applies
PURPOSE: Enable an F32-derived-weight cache for attention Q-B weights.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_BUILD_ARTIFACTS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: boolean-ish, default on for eligible derived artifacts; only exact 0 disables
PURPOSE: Control construction of eligible CUDA derived/repacked weight artifacts.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_COPY_MODEL

PURPOSE: Copy the complete mapped model image into device memory.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_COPY_MODEL_CHUNKED
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset does not force the path; any defined value including 0 is true; eligibility/auto-policy still applies
PURPOSE: Use range-by-range model prefetch/copy preparation instead of the normal bulk preparation.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DECODE_GRAPHS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: boolean, default on; any value starting with 0, or exact off/no/false in listed case variants, disables; oracle flags force off; effective only on one GPU
PURPOSE: Control CUDA Graph capture and replay for decode.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DECODE_GRAPH_LOG
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence diagnostic flag; default off; any defined value including 0 enables
PURPOSE: Log CUDA decode-graph cache misses, capture failures, and lifecycle events.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DECODE_HEADS8_ONLINE

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DISABLE_Q4_ATTN_OUT_HC_FUSE

PURPOSE: Disable fused Q4 attention-output/HC expansion.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DISABLE_Q4_DENSE_PAIR

PURPOSE: Disable the Q4 dense pair CUDA Q4 optimization.

PURPOSE: Request the split Q8 shared-down/HC path when safe.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DISABLE_QKV_RMS_FUSED
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence kill switch; default unset (eligible path remains available); any defined value including 0 disables
PURPOSE: Disable the CUDA QKV RMS fused optimization/path.

PURPOSE: Disable the CUDA shared gate up pair optimization/path.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DISABLE_STREAMING_EXPERT_PERSISTENT_CACHE

PURPOSE: Disable streaming expert persistent cache in CUDA SSD streaming.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DISABLE_STREAMING_PREFILL_BATCH_SELECTED_ADDR
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence kill switch; default unset (eligible path remains available); any defined value including 0 disables
PURPOSE: Disable streaming prefill batch selected addr in CUDA SSD streaming.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DISABLE_STREAMING_PREFILL_BATCH_SELECTED_LOAD
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence kill switch; default unset (eligible path remains available); any defined value including 0 disables
PURPOSE: Disable streaming prefill batch selected load in CUDA SSD streaming.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DISABLE_STREAMING_SELECTED_BATCH_IO
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: false-like-aware flag, default off; 0/false/no/off (case-insensitive) is off, any other nonempty value is on; disable flags dominate
PURPOSE: Disable streaming selected batch I/O in CUDA SSD streaming.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DISABLE_STREAMING_SELECTED_EVENT_PIPELINE

PURPOSE: Disable streaming selected event pipeline in CUDA SSD streaming.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DISABLE_STREAMING_SELECTED_SHARED_OVERLAP

PURPOSE: Disable streaming selected shared overlap in CUDA SSD streaming.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DSPARK_DEVICE_PROPOSER

PURPOSE: Enable the CUDA-resident DSpark proposer.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DSPARK_EXACT2

PURPOSE: Enable the exact two-draft CUDA DSpark support path.

PURPOSE: Enable the exact multi-draft CUDA DSpark support path.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DSPARK_EXACTN_BATCH_HEAD
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: value-aware boolean; default off; unset/empty uses default, exact 0 disables, any other nonempty value enables
PURPOSE: Enable the batched output-head stage for exact-N DSpark verification.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DSPARK_EXACTN_GRAPHS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: value-aware boolean; default off; unset/empty uses default, exact 0 disables, any other nonempty value enables
PURPOSE: Enable CUDA Graph capture for stable exact-N DSpark islands.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DSPARK_NO_DEVICE_PROPOSER
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset does not force the path; any defined value including 0 is true; eligibility/auto-policy still applies
PURPOSE: Disable the CUDA-resident DSpark proposer.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_DSPARK_NO_PADDED_HEAD
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset does not force the path; any defined value including 0 is true; eligibility/auto-policy still applies

PURPOSE: Enable the CUDA IQ2 XXS SSD prefill MMQ experimental path.

PURPOSE: Opt in to the fused Q4 attention-output/HC expansion path.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_ENABLE_Q4_GROUPED_ATTN_A_BATCH

NAME: DS4_CUDA_ENABLE_Q4_K1024_PERSISTENT

PURPOSE: Enable the GB10 persistent-CTA kernel for M=32768, N=1, K=1024 Q4.

NAME: DS4_CUDA_ENABLE_Q8_FOLD

PURPOSE: Enable one-shot producer-to-consumer reuse of freshly quantized Q8_1 data.

NAME: DS4_MTP_BATCH_VERIFY
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag: any defined value, including empty or "0", suppresses the exact two-row decode verifier. Unset selects exact decode-2 when draft_n==2 and either strict mode is active or the build is ROCm; other cases already use the generic verifier.
PURPOSE: Diagnostic rollback from the exact Q8/one-token-equivalent MTP decode-2 verifier to the generic microbatch verifier.

NAME: DS4_MTP_CAPTURE_PREFIX1
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag. In the generic verifier with exactly two drafts it enables prefix-1 state capture under strict mode; non-strict mode already captures prefix-1 without the variable. Unset under strict mode instead snapshots and replays a partial acceptance.
PURPOSE: Let a one-of-two MTP partial acceptance commit the verifier's captured prefix directly, avoiding an exact one-token replay.

NAME: DS4_MTP_CONF_LOG
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag; default off. It forces materialization of full draft logits, computes the top-2 margin, and after a successful generic microbatch verification prints drafted/committed counts, top candidates, margin, target-next and draft-next. Exact decode-2 success does not emit that generic log line.
PURPOSE: Inspect MTP draft confidence and compare the recursive draft token with the target verifier result.

NAME: DS4_MTP_EXACT_REPLAY
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag; default off. In the generic microbatch verifier it forces a pre-verifier frontier snapshot; after verification the snapshot is restored and every accepted draft is decoded sequentially to rebuild exact final state/logits.
PURPOSE: Validate MTP acceptance while committing through the normal one-token decode path rather than retaining batched-verifier state.

NAME: DS4_MTP_FORCE_SNAPSHOT
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag; default off. It forces a speculative-frontier snapshot before the generic verifier regardless of draft count or prefix-capture mode; it does not by itself force restoration or replay after a successful full acceptance.
PURPOSE: Measure/debug snapshot behavior and guarantee a restorable pre-verifier frontier for generic MTP verification.

NAME: DS4_MTP_FULL_LOGITS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag; default off. When set, legacy and recursive MTP draft calls write the full vocabulary logits to s->mtp_logits; unset permits the faster top-token-only output unless confidence/margin logic independently needs logits.
PURPOSE: Force full MTP draft-logit materialization for correctness comparison, inspection, or downstream confidence calculations.

NAME: DS4_MTP_MIN_MARGIN
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: non-negative float; default engine --mtp-margin value
PURPOSE: Set confidence margin threshold for speculative MTP verification.

NAME: DS4_MTP_PROBE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag; default off. For legacy MTP it prepares drafts even when configured depth<=1, compares the previous draft with the next committed token, and prints cumulative hit counts/failures; generated output is unchanged.
PURPOSE: Measure legacy MTP next-token draft accuracy without enabling speculative acceptance.

NAME: DS4_MTP_SPEC_DISABLE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag: any defined value, including empty or "0", disables MTP speculative argmax in CLI/chat/server loops. Unset permits it for greedy temperature<=0 generation with draft depth>1; unrelated split-KV speculation can still be independently requested.
PURPOSE: Fall back from MTP multi-token speculative evaluation to normal one-token session evaluation.

NAME: DS4_MTP_SPEC_LOG
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag; default off. It only emits diagnostics for first-draft misses, exact/generic verifier failures and sequential fallback misses/acceptance outcomes; it does not select a verifier.
PURPOSE: Trace why MTP drafts were accepted, partially accepted, rejected, or sent to sequential fallback.

NAME: DS4_MTP_STRICT
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag; engine quality mode also enables strictness automatically. Strict mode skips the non-strict low-margin shortcut, selects exact decode-2 for two drafts unless DS4_MTP_BATCH_VERIFY is set, and disables default prefix-1 capture unless explicitly restored.
PURPOSE: Force the exact/quality-oriented MTP verification policy on otherwise non-quality runs.

NAME: DS4_MTP_TIMING
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag; default off. When set, timestamps and prints draft, snapshot, verifier, prefix/replay and total durations for the path taken; algorithm selection is otherwise unchanged.
PURPOSE: Profile end-to-end MTP speculative decoding and separate draft, verification and state-commit costs.

PURPOSE: Select the ROCm MXFP4 prefill gate/up kernel that stages eight gate and eight up weight rows in LDS and reuses them across expert tiles of up to 128 tokens.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_ENABLE_MXFP4_ROW64

NAME: DS4_ROCM_ENABLE_MXFP4_TILE32

PURPOSE: Select the ROCm MXFP4 gate/up tile32 kernel, reusing each loaded expert-weight chunk across as many as 32 tokens.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_ENABLE_MXFP4_TILE4
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence opt-in; unset=off; any defined value including empty or 0 enables the candidate when the MXFP4 sorted-tile path has at least 5 tokens and neither TILE32 nor LDSB is selected
PURPOSE: Select the ROCm MXFP4 gate/up tile4 occupancy variant, reducing staged-activation LDS per block.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_CAUSAL_ATTN_GEMM
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Enabled by default when unset. Exact "0" or an empty value disables; every other nonempty value enables (including false/off/no), because cuda_env_present only tests nonempty and != "0". Eligibility still requires causal_range && !has_selected; a failed GEMM helper falls through to the scalar attention kernel.
PURPOSE: Use FP16 BLAS GEMMs for dense causal GLM indexed prefill; =0 is the correctness/performance rollback to the scalar attention kernel.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_DISABLE_STREAMING_EXPERT_CACHE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag: any defined value, including empty or "0", disables. Unset leaves automatic GLM streaming expert-cache eligibility enabled for supported model/quant/quality/SSD configurations. On ROCm builds DS4_METAL_GLM_DISABLE_STREAMING_EXPERT_CACHE is an accepted fallback alias.
PURPOSE: Disable selected/resident streamed-expert cache paths and force generic/full-layer expert handling for GLM SSD streaming.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_DISABLE_STREAMING_SEED_BEFORE_PREFILL
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag: any defined value, including empty or "0", disables. Unset seeds before prefill whenever SSD streaming is active. On ROCm builds DS4_METAL_GLM_DISABLE_STREAMING_SEED_BEFORE_PREFILL is an accepted fallback alias.
PURPOSE: Skip the pre-prefill hotlist seed of the streaming expert cache in both one-shot GLM generation and session setup.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_DISABLE_STREAMING_TOKEN_PREFILL
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag: any defined value, including empty or "0", disables. Unset leaves the token-major path eligible only for SSD streaming, non-quality mode, a nonempty batch fitting full attention, and n_tokens <= the configured nonzero maximum. DS4_METAL_GLM_DISABLE_STREAMING_TOKEN_PREFILL and generic DS4_GLM_DISABLE_STREAMING_TOKEN_PREFILL are also accepted presence aliases.
PURPOSE: Roll back GLM SSD-streaming token-major prefill to the normal prefill implementation.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_GROUPED_QK_LOW
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: sampled once; unset: enabled; present empty or exact 0: disabled; every other present value: enabled
PURPOSE: Selects the grouped shared-input ROCm kernel for eligible multi-token GLM qk-lowrank projection; disabling uses the per-head/per-token projection kernel.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_GROUPED_VALUE_PROJECT
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: sampled once; unset: enabled; present empty or exact 0: disabled; every other present value: enabled
PURPOSE: Selects the grouped shared-input ROCm kernel for eligible multi-token GLM value projection; disabling uses the non-grouped batch projection path.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_LAYER_SLICE_TOKEN_DECODE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Opt-in truthy parser; unset, empty, "0", false, off, or no (case-insensitive words) are false, every other nonempty value is true. Default off and compiled only for ROCm.
PURPOSE: Allow a one-token, pos>0 GLM layer-slice with inter-node input/output hidden buffers to use the optimized resident token graph; without it only the no-hidden-buffer case takes that shortcut.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_SELECTED_ATTN_GEMM
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Enabled by default when unset. Exact "0" or an empty value disables; every other nonempty value enables (including false/off/no). Eligibility still requires !causal_range && has_selected; failure/ineligibility falls through to the scalar attention kernel.
PURPOSE: Gather per-token selected cache rows into FP16 matrices and use strided-batched BLAS GEMMs for GLM selected indexed prefill; =0 forces the scalar path.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_SELECTED_ATTN_HEAD_TILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Unsigned integer read and cached once; valid values are exactly 1,2,4,8,16,32,64. Unset/empty defaults to 16. A nonnumeric, partially parsed, overflowed, or unsupported value prints a warning and uses 16; the effective tile is min(requested,n_head).
PURPOSE: Set how many attention heads each selected-attention GEMM workspace tile processes.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_SELECTED_ATTN_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm glm selected attn profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_STREAMING_ASYNC_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm glm streaming async profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_STREAMING_DECODE_FULL_LAYER_MAP
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag: any defined value, including empty or "0", forces full mapping. Unset uses automatic mapping: resident layers map fully, eligible expert-cache layers use decode-only/expert mapping, otherwise full mapping. DS4_METAL_GLM_STREAMING_DECODE_FULL_LAYER_MAP and generic DS4_GLM_STREAMING_DECODE_FULL_LAYER_MAP are also accepted presence aliases.
PURPOSE: Force every GLM SSD-streaming decode layer through full-layer mapping, bypassing the selected-expert/decode mapping optimization.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_STREAMING_DECODE_SYNC_EACH_LAYER
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: ROCm-only primary value; nonempty takes priority over DS4_METAL_GLM_STREAMING_DECODE_SYNC_EACH_LAYER and the generic DS4_GLM_STREAMING_DECODE_SYNC_EACH_LAYER fallback; empty acts as unset; truthy unless exact 0 or case-insensitive false/off/no; with all aliases unset: false
PURPOSE: For non-static GLM SSD decode on ROCm, opts into a full command/device synchronization after token mapping and every layer; default keeps ordered work queued across layer mappings, and static-map decode bypasses it.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_STREAMING_GROW_CACHE_AFTER_PREFILL
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Enabled by default when absent. If defined, only a truthy nonempty value enables; empty, "0", false, off, or no disable. Growth also requires SSD streaming plus nonzero base cache and prefill-headroom budgets, and occurs only if the recomputed expert count exceeds the current count.
PURPOSE: After successful ROCm GLM prefill, add the released prefill headroom to the dynamic streaming expert-cache byte budget.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_STREAMING_PREFILL_FULL_LAYER
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence force-on; any presence including empty or 0 enables; unset falls back to the Metal alias and then the automatic token threshold (1024 by default on ROCm); DS4_ROCM_DISABLE_GLM_STREAMING_PREFILL_FULL_LAYER dominates
PURPOSE: Forces GLM SSD prefill into full-layer mapping/cache mode even below the automatic large-batch threshold.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_STREAMING_PREFILL_FULL_LAYER_MIN_TOKENS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Positive uint32 threshold parsed with strtoul; ROCm default is 1024. Missing/empty, no leading number, errno/overflow, zero, or >UINT32_MAX returns 1024. The parser does not require end-of-string, so trailing junk after a valid leading number is accepted. A nonempty ROCm value takes precedence; otherwise DS4_METAL_GLM_STREAMING_PREFILL_FULL_LAYER_MIN_TOKENS is a fallback alias.
PURPOSE: Set the automatic token-count crossover for ROCm GLM SSD prefill to load/use full resident expert layers when the layer supports that mode.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_STREAMING_PREFILL_SYNC_EACH_LAYER
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: ROCm-only primary value; nonempty takes priority over DS4_METAL_GLM_STREAMING_PREFILL_SYNC_EACH_LAYER and the generic DS4_GLM_STREAMING_PREFILL_SYNC_EACH_LAYER fallback; empty acts as unset; truthy unless exact 0 or case-insensitive false/off/no; with all aliases unset: false for compact prefill; full-layer prefill always returns true
PURPOSE: For compact GLM SSD prefill on ROCm, opts into a full command/device synchronization at every layer boundary; default preserves queued work across mappings, while full-layer cache mode always synchronizes.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_STREAMING_TOKEN_PREFILL_MAX
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: primary nonempty value, then the Metal alias, then generic DS4_GLM_STREAMING_TOKEN_PREFILL_MAX; parsed by strtoul without requiring full-string consumption; 0 is valid and disables; no digits, ERANGE, or > UINT32_MAX uses the ROCm default 0
PURPOSE: Sets the largest non-quality GLM SSD-prefill chunk eligible for token-major/decode-style execution; ROCm defaults to canonical indexed batch prefill (0 disables token-major mode).

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GLM_VALUE_PROJECT_WAVE_DECODE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Enabled by default when unset. Exact "0" or empty disables; every other nonempty value enables (including false/off/no). It applies only when n_tokens==1; =0 or multi-token input uses the generic per-head batch kernel.
PURPOSE: Select the validated wave-per-output-row ROCm Q8 GLM value-projection kernel for one-token decode; =0 is the generic-kernel rollback.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GRAPH_DUMP_LAYER
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: unsigned layer or all; unset=all layers
PURPOSE: Filter ROCm graph dumps by layer.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GRAPH_DUMP_NAME
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: nonempty substring filter; unset=all tensor names
PURPOSE: Filter ROCm graph dumps by tensor/stage name.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GRAPH_DUMP_NONINVASIVE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: truthy value under the shared parser; unset lets dumping select conservative kernels
PURPOSE: Keep production ROCm kernel selection while graph dumping.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GRAPH_DUMP_POS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: unsigned token position; unset=all positions
PURPOSE: Filter ROCm graph dumps by position.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GRAPH_DUMP_PREFIX
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: nonempty output path prefix; unset=off
PURPOSE: Enable ROCm intermediate graph/tensor dumps.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GRAPH_DUMP_TRACE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Emit trace diagnostics for rocm graph dump trace.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GRAPH_OUTPUT_ROW
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Nonempty string with a leading strtoul-parsable unsigned value < n_tokens selects that zero-based row. Default, empty, unparsable, or out-of-range selects n_tokens-1. Trailing characters are accepted because full consumption/errno are not checked. A nonempty ROCm value takes precedence; otherwise DS4_METAL_GRAPH_OUTPUT_ROW is a fallback alias.
PURPOSE: Choose which prefill hidden-state row is sent through the output head to produce logits, primarily for graph/correctness diagnostics.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GRAPH_PREFILL_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm graph prefill profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GRAPH_PREFILL_SPLIT_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm graph prefill split profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_GRAPH_TOKEN_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm graph token profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_INDEXER_STAGE_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm indexer stage profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_LAYER_STAGE_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm layer stage profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_LAYER_STAGE_PROFILE_LAYER
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: layer filter subordinate to DS4_ROCM_LAYER_STAGE_PROFILE; unset or whitespace-only: all layers allowed by the parent flag; otherwise the whitespace-trimmed value must be a complete base-10 strtoul result <= UINT32_MAX equal to the current layer; invalid values match none
PURPOSE: Restricts the ROCm layer/prefill stage profiler to one layer; it does not enable profiling by itself.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_MOE_DECODE_DOWN_RPB
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: sampled once; nonempty value is parsed by strtoul (a numeric prefix is sufficient), cast to uint32_t, and accepted only if 1/2/4/8/16/32; unset/empty/invalid inherits DS4_ROCM_MOE_DECODE_RPB, with defaults quality=8, non-quality SSD=2, resident=1
PURPOSE: Sets output rows (warps) per block for ROCm Q2_K routed-MoE decode down-projection kernels; threads per block are value * 32.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_MOE_DECODE_GATE_RPB
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: sampled once; nonempty value is parsed by strtoul (a numeric prefix is sufficient), cast to uint32_t, and accepted only if 1/2/4/8/16/32; unset/empty/invalid defaults to 1 in non-quality SSD mode when DS4_ROCM_MOE_DECODE_RPB is unset/empty, otherwise inherits the resolved base RPB
PURPOSE: Sets output rows (warps) per block for ROCm Q2_K routed-MoE decode gate/up kernels; threads per block are value * 32.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_MOE_DECODE_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm moe decode profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_MOE_DECODE_RPB
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: sampled once; nonempty value is parsed by strtoul (a numeric prefix is sufficient), cast to uint32_t, and accepted only if 1/2/4/8/16/32; unset/empty/invalid default: quality=8, non-quality SSD=2, resident=1
PURPOSE: Sets the base ROCm Q2_K decode-MoE rows-per-block value inherited by gate/up and down controls, except the automatic SSD gate specialization defaults to 1 when this variable is unset/empty.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_MOE_PATH_DEBUG
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence diagnostic; unset=off; any defined value including empty or 0 enables it
PURPOSE: Print ROCm routed-MoE path selection, sorted-tile scratch state, and MXFP4 gate/up launch diagnostics to stderr.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_MOE_WRITE_CLAMPED_ACT
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence sentinel: any defined value, including empty or "0", is active; DS4_METAL_MOE_WRITE_CLAMPED_ACT is an accepted fallback alias. On ROCm the variable is only consumed as a path-admission veto: it disables selected-expert cache/address-table, selected-slot and CPU-router/fused optimized paths. No ROCm call site parses a clamp amount or directly enables a write-clamped kernel.
PURPOSE: Force shared graph selection away from optimizations incompatible with the clamped-intermediate MoE diagnostic; on ROCm this is a compatibility/rollback gate, not itself a clamped-write implementation.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_MXFP4_DOWN_RGROUP
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: nonempty value is parsed by strtol and a numeric prefix is sufficient; integers 1..8 are accepted; unset, empty, invalid, or out-of-range values use 1
PURPOSE: Set how many 32-row output blocks each ROCm MXFP4 tiled down-projection block computes, reducing the first launch-grid dimension as the value increases.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_Q4_GROUPED_ATTN_A_STATS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Print counters for rocm q4 grouped attn a stats.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_Q4_PREFILL_TILE8_STATS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Print counters for rocm q4 prefill tile8 stats.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_Q8_DECODE_SHAREDX_64K
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: sampled once; unset: enabled; present empty or exact 0: disabled; every other present value: enabled; effective only for one-token non-prequant Q8_0 matmul with 8192 < in_dim <= 16384
PURPOSE: Allows the ROCm shared-input Q8 decode kernel to use up to 64 KiB dynamic LDS for wide inputs; an unsupported/failed LDS launch automatically falls back to the regular kernel.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_Q_STAGE_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm q stage profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_REQUIRE_Q4_GROUPED_ATTN_A
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence fail-closed assertion; also requests candidate unless disabled
PURPOSE: Require rocm require q4 grouped attn a and fail instead of silently falling back.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_REQUIRE_Q4_PREFILL_TILE8
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence fail-closed assertion for eligible TILE8 calls
PURPOSE: Require rocm require q4 prefill tile8 and fail instead of silently falling back.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_DECODE_PREFILL_MAX
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: primary nonempty value over the Metal alias; parsed by strtol when it has a numeric prefix (trailing text is accepted); <= 0 disables, values > UINT32_MAX clamp, no numeric prefix uses automatic default: 64 for Flash with uniform Q4_K/MXFP4 experts, 18 for other Pro/Flash, otherwise 0; the disable flag dominates
PURPOSE: Sets the largest short, non-quality SSD-streaming prefill batch routed through the decode-style path instead of canonical layer-major prefill.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_EXPERT_AUTO_PRELOAD_CAP
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: primary nonempty value over the Metal alias; strict full-string strtoul; valid values > UINT32_MAX clamp, invalid uses 4096, and 0 means no cap (not disabled); when CLI preload is auto/0, unset defaults to cap 4096 except ROCm GLM52, where absent/empty disables automatic preload entirely
PURPOSE: Caps the number of hot experts synchronously seeded into the SSD-streaming expert cache in automatic preload mode; an explicit CLI preload count bypasses this cap, and setting this variable opts ROCm GLM52 back into auto preload.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_EXPERT_CACHE_VERBOSE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset=off
PURPOSE: Print verbose ROCm streaming expert-cache seed/load diagnostics.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_EXPERT_HOTLIST
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Nonempty filesystem path; a nonempty ROCm value takes precedence, otherwise DS4_METAL_STREAMING_EXPERT_HOTLIST is a fallback. The file contains whitespace-separated layer expert hits rows; blank/comment lines are ignored, zero-hit rows skipped, malformed/open/read errors fail seeding. Unset/empty uses the built-in Pro/Flash/GLM52 hotlist. Effective only when non-cold SSD hotlist seeding is enabled and cache/preload budget is nonzero.
PURPOSE: Select a custom ranked expert hotlist used to preseed the streaming resident expert cache before decode.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_EXPERT_HOTLIST_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm streaming expert hotlist profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_MAP_TRACE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Emit trace diagnostics for rocm streaming map trace.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_BATCH_SELECTED_ADDR_MAX
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: primary nonempty value over the Metal alias; strtol accepts a numeric prefix; <= 0 returns 0, > UINT32_MAX clamps, invalid uses ROCm default UINT32_MAX for Pro/Flash/GLM52 and 0 otherwise
PURPOSE: Sets the inclusive upper token-count bound for automatically using selected-expert address-table kernels during eligible non-quality SSD batch prefill; 0 disables automatic selection.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_BATCH_SELECTED_ADDR_MIN
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: primary nonempty value over the Metal alias; strtol accepts a numeric prefix; <= 0 returns 0, > UINT32_MAX clamps, invalid uses ROCm default 2 for Pro/Flash/GLM52 and 0 otherwise
PURPOSE: Sets the inclusive lower token-count bound for automatically using selected-expert address-table kernels during eligible non-quality SSD batch prefill (the path independently requires more than one token).

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_CACHE_SEED_K
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: primary nonempty value over the Metal alias; strict full-string strtoul; unset/empty/invalid: 1; 0 disables; positive values clamp to 64; ignored unless SSD streaming and DS4_ROCM_ENABLE_STREAMING_PREFILL_CACHE_SEED (or Metal alias) is present
PURPOSE: Chooses how many trailing token router selections per layer are captured from prefill and used to seed the streaming expert cache afterward.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_CACHE_SEED_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm streaming prefill cache seed profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_LAYER_MADVISE_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm streaming prefill layer madvise profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_LAYER_PAGEIN_NO_OVERLAP
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag: any defined value, including empty or "0", disables overlap. Default overlap is enabled only if this, PREPARE_NO_OVERLAP, DISABLE_*_PREPARE_OVERLAP, and DISABLE_*_PAGEIN_OVERLAP are all absent. The corresponding DS4_METAL name is an accepted fallback alias. In current code PAGEIN_NO_OVERLAP and PREPARE_NO_OVERLAP are exact synonyms.
PURPOSE: Serialize SSD-streaming prefill layer page-in/preparation instead of overlapping preparation of upcoming layers.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_LAYER_PAGEIN_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm streaming prefill layer pagein profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_LAYER_PAGEIN_THREADS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: legacy fallback read only when DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_LAYER_PREPARE_THREADS and its Metal alias are absent/empty; strict full-string strtoul; unset/empty across both names: 8; invalid or 0: 1; values > 16 clamp to 16
PURPOSE: Sets worker count for full-layer SSD-prefill preparation (page touch, pread, readahead, or madvise) when the canonical PREPARE_THREADS control is not set.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_LAYER_PREAD_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm streaming prefill layer pread profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_LAYER_PREPARE_AHEAD
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: primary nonempty value over the Metal alias; strict full-string strtoul; unset/empty: 1; invalid or 0: 1; values > 4 clamp to 4
PURPOSE: Sets how many future layer-preparation jobs may be queued concurrently while SSD-prefill preparation overlap is enabled.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_LAYER_PREPARE_NO_OVERLAP
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag: any defined value, including empty or "0", disables overlap. Default overlap is enabled only if this, PAGEIN_NO_OVERLAP, DISABLE_*_PREPARE_OVERLAP, and DISABLE_*_PAGEIN_OVERLAP are all absent. The corresponding DS4_METAL name is an accepted fallback alias. In current code PREPARE_NO_OVERLAP and PAGEIN_NO_OVERLAP are exact synonyms.
PURPOSE: Serialize SSD-streaming prefill layer preparation/page-in instead of overlapping preparation of upcoming layers.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_LAYER_PREPARE_THREADS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: primary nonempty value over the Metal alias; strict full-string strtoul; unset/empty falls back to LAYER_PAGEIN_THREADS, then default 8; invalid or 0: 1; values > 16 clamp to 16
PURPOSE: Sets worker count used to split full-layer SSD-prefill page-touch, pread, readahead, or madvise preparation ranges.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_LAYER_READAHEAD_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm streaming prefill layer readahead profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_SELECTED_MADVISE_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm streaming prefill selected madvise profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_SELECTED_MADVISE_THREADS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: legacy fallback read only for selected-expert madvise preparation when DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_SELECTED_PREPARE_THREADS and its Metal alias are absent/empty; strict full-string strtoul; if all selected controls are unset it inherits layer preparation threads (default 8); invalid or 0: 1; values > 16 clamp to 16
PURPOSE: Sets worker count for selected-expert madvise preparation under its legacy name; non-madvise selected page-in always uses one worker.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_SELECTED_PAGEIN_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm streaming prefill selected pagein profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_SELECTED_PREPARE_GAP
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: primary nonempty value over the Metal alias; strict full-string strtoul; unset/empty/invalid: 0; values > 8 clamp to 8
PURPOSE: For selected-expert madvise preparation, merges selected expert runs separated by at most this many unselected expert IDs, trading broader hints for fewer ranges.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_SELECTED_PREPARE_THREADS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: primary nonempty value over the Metal alias; strict full-string strtoul; for selected-expert madvise, unset/empty falls back to SELECTED_MADVISE_THREADS then layer preparation threads (default 8); invalid or 0: 1; values > 16 clamp to 16; non-madvise selected page-in ignores it and uses 1
PURPOSE: Sets worker count for selected-expert madvise preparation using the canonical control name.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_SELECTED_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm streaming prefill selected profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_SELECTED_READAHEAD_GAP
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: primary nonempty value over the Metal alias; strict full-string strtoul; unset/empty/invalid: 0; values > 8 clamp to 8
PURPOSE: For selected-expert file readahead, merges selected expert runs separated by at most this many unselected expert IDs, reducing readahead calls at the cost of hinting extra weights.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAMING_PREFILL_SELECTED_READAHEAD_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence/nonempty diagnostic; unset=off (path-valued DUMP names are noted by purpose)
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for rocm streaming prefill selected readahead profile.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAM_CACHE_LAYER_STATS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset=off
PURPOSE: Collect per-layer ROCm streaming cache statistics; also enables aggregate stats.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAM_CACHE_STATS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset=off unless layer stats are enabled
PURPOSE: Collect aggregate ROCm streaming cache statistics.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAM_EVICT_PAST_LAYERS_FIRST
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: nonempty and not 0 enables; unset/empty/0=off
PURPOSE: Prefer evicting cached experts from already-processed layers.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAM_FREE_RESERVE_GB
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: integer 2..64 GiB; default 16
PURPOSE: Reserve unified-memory headroom while growing the ROCm expert cache.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAM_MODEL_CACHE_GB
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: positive GiB integer; unset/invalid uses automatic streaming model cache limit
PURPOSE: Cap cached streaming model spans.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAM_NO_DIRECT
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: nonempty and not 0 disables direct reads; unset/empty/0 keeps direct I/O eligible
PURPOSE: Force the buffered ROCm SSD-streaming read path.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAM_Q8_F16_CACHE_GB
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: non-negative GiB integer; unset/invalid uses automatic Q8-F16 cache limit
PURPOSE: Cap converted Q8-to-F16 weights in SSD mode.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAM_READ_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: nonempty and not 0 enables; unset/empty/0=off
PURPOSE: Print ROCm SSD-streaming read/locality statistics at exit.

NAME: DS4_ROCM_STREAM_READ_WORKERS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: integer; default DS4_ROCM_STREAM_READ_DEFAULT_WORKERS; 0 coerces to 1; capped at compile-time max
PURPOSE: Set parallel ROCm SSD read/upload workers.

NAME: DS4_SERVER_BATCH_LOG
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Pure presence flag read once when the decode worker starts; default off. Any defined value, including empty or "0", logs one record per coalesced decode batch with count, elapsed milliseconds and ok/error status.
PURPOSE: Observe server-side decode coalescing size, latency and result without changing batching behavior.

NAME: DS4_SERVER_DECODE_COALESCE_US
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: integer 0..100000 microseconds; default 2000; 0 disables wait
PURPOSE: Control server micro-batch coalescing delay.

NAME: DS4_SSD_AUTO_CACHE_PCT
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: integer 50..95; default 80
PURPOSE: Choose the RAM percentage used by automatic SSD expert-cache planning.

NAME: DS4_TEST_METAL_EXACTN_ORACLE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag compiled only with DS4_TEST_HOOKS; unset is off; any defined value enables
PURPOSE: Force allocation of the Metal exact-N verifier/oracle workspace in test builds.

NAME: DS4_TP_ABLATE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: comma/list string matched for hcpre,router,kv,compidx; unset=no ablation; must match on both ranks
PURPOSE: Skip named TP encode chains for timing; output is semantically wrong.

NAME: DS4_TP_EVENT_GATES
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset uses lower-latency slab flag gates when available
PURPOSE: Fall back to Metal shared-event arrival gates.

NAME: DS4_TP_GATE_PROFILE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence diagnostic flag; unset=off
PURPOSE: Collect timing/profile diagnostics for tp gate profile.

NAME: DS4_TP_GATE_TRACE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence diagnostic flag; unset=off
PURPOSE: Emit trace diagnostics for tp gate trace.

NAME: DS4_TP_KEEPALIVE_ITERS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: atoi unsigned iteration count; default 1200000
PURPOSE: Tune work per Metal TP keep-alive dispatch.

NAME: DS4_TP_KEEPALIVE_TGS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: integer 1..2048; invalid/out of range uses 1
PURPOSE: Tune threadgroups per Metal TP keep-alive dispatch.

NAME: DS4_TP_NO_KEEPALIVE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: presence flag; unset starts Metal TP keep-alive
PURPOSE: Disable the Metal TP GPU keep-alive worker.

NAME: DS4_TP_PREFILL_SPLIT_MIN
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: atoi token threshold; default 32; values below 2 clamp to 2
PURPOSE: Set when TP prefill row-splits the replicated shared expert.

NAME: DS4_TP_SUBGATE_PIPELINE
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: nonempty integer; nonzero enables; default off; must match on both ranks
PURPOSE: Enable TP prefill sub-chunk gate pipelining.

NAME: DS4_TP_TIMEOUT_SEC
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: atoi seconds stored unsigned; default DS4_TP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SEC
PURPOSE: Override TP control/data socket operation timeout.

NAME: DS4_CHROME
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: executable path; unset auto-detects Chrome/Chromium via standard paths and PATH
PURPOSE: Select the browser executable used by web tooling.

NAME: DS4_GGUF_DIR
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: path; default repository gguf/ directory
PURPOSE: Choose the model download directory.

NAME: FLATTEN_DOWNLOADS
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: exact integer 1 enables; unset or 0 preserves normal shard paths
PURPOSE: Move downloaded Hugging Face files from nested cache paths into the requested output directory.

NAME: FORCE_HF_DOWNLOAD
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: exact integer 1 enables; unset or 0 uses the available downloader automatically
PURPOSE: Force download_model.sh to use hf download instead of curl when available.

NAME: HF_TOKEN
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: secret string; unset tries cached Hugging Face token or unauthenticated download
PURPOSE: Authenticate Hugging Face downloads.

NAME: HOME
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: Filesystem directory string. In ds4-agent, unset or empty falls back to "." for the default cache and history roots; the web helper applies the same fallback for its browser profile. A nonempty value roots .ds4/kvcache, .ds4_agent_history and .ds4/browser.
PURPOSE: Choose the user's persistent ds4-agent cache, line-history and Chrome-profile base directory.

NAME: <NAME_FROM_--api-key-env>
VALUE_DEFAULT_SEMANTICS: dynamic environment-variable name; no fixed identifier; overrides endpoint-derived key name

NAME: DS4_DSPARK_FIXTURE_TEMPERATURE

NAME: DS4_DSPARK_FIXTURE_TOKENS

NAME: DS4_DSPARK_FIXTURE_TOP_P

NAME: DS4_DSPARK_SSD_VERIFY_BLOCK_MAX
